Symbol:
mac_address
Type:
ara::core::Optional< std::uint64_t >
Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint64_t> mac_address;
Description:
std::uint64_t optinal member variable which represents the MAC address part of the IEEE1722
defined stream id header field.
This is used for a unambiguous identification of the IEEE1722 stream. Please note, the stream
id consist of the following fragment: 48bit MAC address and 16bit unique id.
The value range for mac_address shall be:
0x00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 ... 0x00 00 FF FF FF FF FF FF: valid
0x00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 ... 0xFF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF: not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set the MAC address part which is configured, if it is not
provided by the application.
Visibility:
protected
⌋
